title: Dai is deliberately kept a valid product while its brand presence is withdrawn
content:
A.5.1.1.2 requires Dai to remain a valid token and product, with no actively maintained brand presence beyond community assets, educational material and its token name.

The two halves pull in opposite directions on purpose. Dai keeps working — holders are not forced to migrate and nothing is deprecated at the protocol level — while brand spend moves to the new identity. Marketing attention is withdrawn without withdrawing the product.

This is the mechanism by which a rebrand avoids stranding existing users: continuity of function is guaranteed in governance text, so the sunset is a reduction in promotion rather than a removal of capability.
description: A.5.1.1.2 keeps Dai functional and redeemable while limiting brand investment to community assets, educational material and the token name — a managed sunset, not a deprecation.
